target_strategy.positioning: Backend-focused Full Stack Engineer with commercial Node.js/TypeScript production experience, React/Next.js contribution, API and database integration depth, and current portfolio work in AI-assisted workflow tooling.
target_strategy.main_angle: Position Denys Strakhov as a backend-first fullstack engineer who can move across backend services, APIs, databases, BFF layers and React/Next.js features while supporting production workflows. Three strongest supporting arguments are: 1) cross-layer product delivery on the EPAM large-scale multi-locale e-commerce platform, backed by the EPAM platform overview case; 2) automation of operational workflows with measurable manual-work reduction, backed by the Amplience automation/webhooks/mass-updates case; 3) reliable integration and production ownership across long-running synchronization, product-data and notification workflows, backed by the ProductsUp sync, CommerceTools integration and customer-notification incident cases.
risk_mitigation: Use backend-focused fullstack wording rather than frontend-specialist or evenly balanced fullstack claims.
Show React and Next.js as commercial production contribution while keeping Node.js, TypeScript, APIs and backend reliability central.
Keep payments, KYC, risk, FX, rewards, mobile collaboration, direct customer discovery and commercial AI product delivery out because they are not evidenced.
Present JobFlow and AI Job Assistant strictly as personal portfolio evidence, not commercial AI or NestJS production experience.
Do not claim strong spoken English, fluent English or direct customer/product ownership; keep communication evidence factual and prepare these points for interview.
Use Cologne and Germany work authorization as a clear location fit without implying German professional fluency.

cv_content.headline: Backend-focused Full Stack Engineer | Node.js | TypeScript | React/Next.js | Azure | PostgreSQL
summary: Backend-focused Full Stack Engineer based in Cologne, Germany, with commercial Node.js and TypeScript experience across backend services, APIs, BFF layers and production React/Next.js features.
Built and maintained integration-heavy e-commerce workflows using Azure Functions, REST APIs, PostgreSQL, Cosmos DB, Redis and third-party platforms including Amplience, CommerceTools and ProductsUp.
Delivered workflow automation, long-running synchronization and production debugging with retries, idempotency, logging and Azure Application Insights/KQL.
Current portfolio work includes JobFlow, a NestJS/TypeScript backend-first AI workflow project; Python/FastAPI/OpenAI work remains personal-project evidence.
Authorized to work in Germany; based in Cologne and open to remote or Cologne-based hybrid work.

current_work_block.role_line: Freelance Software Development, Backend Portfolio Projects & Relocation
current_work_block.stable_intro: Continued active software development after relocating from Ukraine to Germany through small freelance tasks, backend-focused portfolio projects, structured upskilling, and local volunteering.

bullets.text: Supported small Node.js/React improvements on an independent basis, including feature additions, bug fixes, API-related changes, UI adjustments and maintenance tasks.

Built JobFlow CV Pipeline, a backend-first NestJS/TypeScript portfolio project for vacancy analysis, targeted CV generation, evidence-based claim validation and deterministic PDF export; implemented human-in-the-loop AI workflow concepts, Evidence Guard, prompt versioning, artifact traceability, token/cost tracking and backend HTML-to-PDF export without AI token usage.
Continued Python/FastAPI backend learning through personal projects using PostgreSQL, SQLAlchemy, Pytest, OpenAI API and GitHub Actions.
Volunteered as IT Technician at HEY, ALTER! Köln e.V., refurbishing donated laptops for school students in Cologne.
Worked on a large-scale multi-locale e-commerce platform for a major European retailer, contributing across Node.js/TypeScript backend services, BFF/API layers and React/Next.js features.
Integrated Amplience, CommerceTools and ProductsUp to support content workflows, product information, product enrichment and downstream product-data synchronization.

Automated selected Amplience CMS workflows with webhook-based Azure Functions, handling create, update, publish and unpublish events, validation, logging, retries, cache updates and mass field updates; reduced selected manual operations from hours to minutes.

Built the initial implementation and later maintained/contributed to a ProductsUp synchronization flow using Azure Durable Functions, CommerceTools enrichment, Azure Blob Storage, CSV/ZIP generation, Stream API uploads, retries, idempotency and per-locale result logging.
Supported long-running product synchronization processing approximately 20,000–40,000 products per sync across changed locales, with partial-failure logging and product-ID-based duplicate prevention.

Integrated CommerceTools product data into PDP, listing, BFF/backend and ProductsUp enrichment flows, handling up to approximately 100,000 unique products, 50+ attributes, optional fields, pagination where supported and custom batching where needed.

Contributed to production customer-notification flows and investigated cross-service failures using Azure Application Insights and KQL, tracing issues across upstream, intermediate and downstream services and improving logs and alerting.
bullets.evidence_source: Career_Case_Deep_Dives_RU_v0_6_current_work_sync.md — Cases 4 and 8; Master_CV_RU_v0_6_current_work_sync.md — EPAM production experience

bullets.text: Wrote and maintained backend unit tests with Jest, worked within SonarQube quality gates, participated in code review and releases, and collaborated with frontend, QA, BA, Product Owners, DevOps and other service teams.

Developed backend functionality for a production public-sector budget accounting system, focusing on PostgreSQL-heavy features, complex business logic, financial data integrity and legacy maintenance.
Planned and executed high-risk PostgreSQL migrations for financial accounting data, including multi-table account-splitting changes, transactions, validation and rollback planning where possible.
Implemented complex payroll-related business logic for vacation payment calculations with multiple regulatory scenarios and reporting updates.
bullets.evidence_source: Career_Case_Deep_Dives_RU_v0_6_current_work_sync.md — Case 6; Master_CV_RU_v0_6_current_work_sync.md — Factor–IT vacation payment case

bullets.text: Optimized complex PostgreSQL queries using joins, subqueries, indexes, query simplification and intermediate tables, and supported production users through bug fixing and releases.
Completed a full-time Node.js transition internship focused on JavaScript backend development, REST APIs, Express/NestJS basics, MongoDB, Docker basics and code review.
